items.item_text: 01. How have you demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students?

02. What interests you most about serving as a Division Area Office Coordinator in a newly formed Business and Consumer Sciences Division, and what would you hope to contribute over the next three to five years? Describe how you would approach learning the needs of the different programs, building trust with faculty and staff, and becoming someone the Dean and program leaders can rely on to anticipate needs and improve division operations.

03. Our division is committed to creating an accessible, welcoming, and student-centered experience. Describe how you would help students navigate college processes, access the support they need, and see a connection between their academic program, their goals, and their sense of belonging at the College. Please provide an example of how you have helped a student or customer feel supported, included, and connected.

04. Describe a time when you were responsible for coordinating multiple competing priorities, deadlines, people, or projects. How did you determine what needed to be addressed first, how did you keep track of the details, and how did you communicate priorities to others? What was the outcome?

05. The Business and Consumer Sciences Division brings together programs with different histories, disciplines, and perspectives. Describe how you would help create a sense of unity, collaboration, and shared purpose when working with people who may be experiencing change or have different perspectives. Provide an example of how you have helped a team navigate change while maintaining positive relationships and a focus on shared goals.

06. This is an in-house-only recruitment: This position is open to internal permanent and temporary employees of the Coast Community College District (CCCD). External candidates are NOT eligible to apply. If you are not a current CCCD employee, please do not apply at this time. Are you currently employed by the Coast Community College District as an active employee? Options: Yes | No

08. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current resume (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 3. A cover letter (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 4. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses required as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No

09. Please confirm that all responses provided in this application are your own original work and were not generated or assisted by artificial intelligence tools or software. By answering 'Yes,' you attest to the authenticity of your responses. Options: Yes | No
May require a valid driver’s license.
